default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-638.title: Straight-line move fade
E-638.hypothesis: A very efficient (near straight-line) move far larger than usual leaves late chasers with no pullback cushion; liquidity providers fade it.

E-639.title: Higher-low run structure break
E-639.hypothesis: A run of rising lows is a staircase of dip buyers; the first close under the last low strands them and the move follows (mirror for lower highs).

E-640.title: Range-expansion onset follow
E-640.hypothesis: When recent bar ranges jump relative to the last hour, new information or forced flow is arriving; follow the net direction of the burst.

E-641.title: Rising-volume close ramp follow
E-641.hypothesis: Consecutive same-colour bars each on more volume than the last show aggression building; follow.

E-642.title: Wide outside-bar close follow
E-642.hypothesis: A wide bar engulfing the prior range that closes near one end settles the auction in that direction.

E-643.title: Stalled-run exhaustion fade
E-643.hypothesis: After a run of same-direction closes, a bar with a tiny body shows the aggressor ran out of volume; fade it.

E-644.title: VWAP slope flip with price side
E-644.hypothesis: When the session VWAP turns up while price is above it, the average cost of the day's volume is rising with price: buyers are in control; mirror for sells.

E-645.title: Double-EMA slope turn follow
E-645.hypothesis: A double-exponential average removes most lag; its slope turning marks a trend change earlier than a single EMA cross.

E-646.title: Contracting-range break follow
E-646.hypothesis: Several bars of strictly shrinking range mean participants are withdrawing; the first close beyond the last bar releases stored order flow.

E-647.title: VWAP-opposed close-extreme fade
E-647.hypothesis: A new short-term close high while price is below the day's VWAP is a rally into trapped-buyer supply; fade it (mirror above VWAP).
